tests: a line PrintText prints with no colour is one of the IDE's yellow message lines
a line printed with an RGB colour, with 0 or with one of the IDE's own codes is drawn as one with no colour
a line printed with &HFD0000, the IDE's code for a native exception, is drawn as one with no colour and turns no TRACE-MODE on
steps:
This is an add-in project: building it makes a DLL that the IDE's compiler loads on every start until the DLL is removed. Install it knowingly, in an IDE you can restart, and remove it afterwards.
1. Open printtext-colorrgb-ignored.twinproj and build it for Win32. Copy Build\PrintTextColorRgbIgnored_win32.dll into %APPDATA%\twinBASIC\addins\win32\ and restart the IDE. Open any project: the toolbar has a button, Print in colour.
2. Click Print in colour. The DEBUG CONSOLE prints no colour, orange, red and blue, all four in the same yellow.
3. Close the IDE and delete PrintTextColorRgbIgnored_win32.dll from %APPDATA%\twinBASIC\addins\win32\.
Asserted on BETA 1042 by `addin-test.bat --only console-colour` (the ConsoleColourProbe add-in in test/addin/probes/consolecolour, of which this project is a cut-down copy).
